_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on games-steamcmd pixark/egg-pix-a-r-k.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence). Octail keeps the Windows server under Wine, the map URL and the start options (CubeWorld_Light, raw sockets, -NoBattlEye, -nosteamclient, -NoHangDetection) and changes the rest: Source RCON (ARK's, enabled on the map URL) with the panel's generated password (ServerAdminPassword is the RCON password, hidden) carries console commands, ServerChat broadcasts and a SaveWorld before Ctrl+C at stop (the wine image's rcon client, in a trap: the image runs the line in bash as PID 1) instead of upstream's kill (^^C); automatic query (+2), RCON (+3) and cube (+4) ports instead of empty defaults, and the port after the game port reserved (optional) for the engine's second UDP socket; the world (-cubeworld) is its own variable instead of the server name, the seeds are settings, the session name refuses ? and double quotes (it is part of the map URL), passwords are one word; the server's log (ShooterGame/Saved/Logs/ShooterGame.log) is followed on the console, the start is detected from 'Full Startup' or the bound game port (x_octail.features.ready); the Steam client libraries (app 1007) are copied next to the executable; vcrun2022 is installed into the Wine prefix once (WINETRICKS_RUN; upstream: vcrun2019 dotnet6); the alternate config/save folders are dropped (the defaults under ShooterGame/Saved/ are used); the pixark tag, the Steam query (A2S) for player counts, the Players tab (features.players: "ark" over the same RCON, listing/kicking/banning — same ARK admin-command vocabulary as ARK: Survival Evolved and Ascended, but PixARK itself wasn't independently verified against a live server in this pass, only assumed from the earlier audit's research that it borrowed ARK's admin commands too), install sandbox defaults and resource hints, curl with timeouts and retries, and the install fails when SteamCMD didn't download the server. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration". SteamCMD exits 0 even when an install failed (Missing configuration), so its retry loop counts a run as done only on SteamCMD's "Success! App" line.
name: PixARK
author: eggs@octail.net
description: PixARK: survive, tame dinosaurs and build in a cube world (ARK's voxel spin-off). The Windows dedicated server, run under Wine.

startup_commands.Default: for dll in steamclient64.dll tier0_s64.dll vstdlib_s64.dll; do [ -f "${dll}" ] && cp -u "${dll}" ShooterGame/Binaries/Win64/; done; wine ./ShooterGame/Binaries/Win64/PixARKServer.exe "CubeWorld_Light?listen?DelayRegisterServer=True?bRawSockets=True?SessionName={{SESSION_NAME}}?ServerPassword={{SERVER_PASSWORD}}?ServerAdminPassword={{RCON_PASSWORD}}?MaxPlayers={{MAX_PLAYERS}}?RCONEnabled=True?RCONPort={{RCON_PORT}}" -cubeworld={{WORLD_NAME}} -Seed={{SEED}} -OreSeed={{ORE_SEED}} -Port={{SERVER_PORT}} -QueryPort={{QUERY_PORT}} -CubePort={{CUBE_PORT}} -server -log -gameplaylogging -CULTUREFORCOOKING=en -NoBattlEye -nosteamclient -NoHangDetection & PIX_PID=$!; trap "rcon -a 127.0.0.1:${RCON_PORT} -p ${RCON_PASSWORD} SaveWorld >/dev/null 2>&1; kill -INT ${PIX_PID} 2>/dev/null; wait ${PIX_PID}" INT TERM; tail -c0 -F /home/container/ShooterGame/Saved/Logs/ShooterGame.log --pid=${PIX_PID} 2>/dev/null & wait ${PIX_PID}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
## Octail curated install: SteamCMD downloads the Windows build of the server (it runs under Wine).
## Server Files: /mnt/server

## anonymous login: this server needs no Steam account
STEAM_USER=anonymous
STEAM_PASS=""
STEAM_AUTH=""

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp || exit 1
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 300 --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz || { echo "Downloading SteamCMD failed."; exit 1; }
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd || exit 1

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) +app_update 1007 +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) validate +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log && grep -q "Success! App '" /tmp/steamcmd.log && ! grep -q "ERROR! Failed to install app" /tmp/steamcmd.log; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/ShooterGame/Binaries/Win64/PixARKServer.exe" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the PixARK dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi

## Octail: the Steam client libraries (app 1007, downloaded with the server) next to the server's executable
cd /mnt/server
for dll in steamclient64.dll tier0_s64.dll vstdlib_s64.dll; do
    [[ -f "$dll" ]] && cp -fv "$dll" ShooterGame/Binaries/Win64/
done
mkdir -p /mnt/server/ShooterGame/Saved/Logs

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Session Name
variables.description: The name in the server list (no ? or double quotes).

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Optional: players must enter it to join (letters, digits, - and _). Empty = no password.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: The most players online at once.

variables.name: World Name
variables.description: The cube world to load (letters, digits, - and _); a new name creates a new world.

variables.name: Seed
variables.description: The terrain seed of a new world.

variables.name: Ore Seed
variables.description: The ore seed of a new world.

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: Steam query (UDP), for the server list. Set by Octail when the server is created (two after the game port).

variables.name: RCON Port
variables.description: RCON (TCP), used by the console. Set by Octail when the server is created (three after the game port).

variables.name: Cube Port
variables.description: The terrain port (UDP). Set by Octail when the server is created (four after the game port).

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Generated by Octail when the server is created; also the in-game admin password. The console uses it.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Update the server with SteamCMD before every start (1 = on, 0 = off).

variables.name: Windows Install
variables.description: Downloads the Windows build (the server runs under Wine).

variables.name: Winetricks
variables.description: Installed into the Wine prefix once, at the first start (the server needs the Visual C++ runtime).
